title: Queue and Deque Quiz
description: A quick check to review queues and Python deque.

questions.questionText: Which rule does a queue follow?
questions.explanation: A queue follows First In, First Out. The first item added is removed first.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following code?
questions.codeSnippet:
from collections import deque

queue = deque()
queue.append("A")
queue.append("B")
queue.append("C")
print(queue.popleft())
questions.explanation: popleft() removes the first item from the queue, which is A.
